'''Amy Palant''' (born 1979) is an American voice actress and singer for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Pokémon roles==
Palant's first role in Pokémon was that of {{jo|Maya}}. Later, Palant returned to the series in ''[[DP062|Tanks for the Memories!]]'' after [[DuArt Film & Video]] took over the dubbing from [[TAJ Productions]].
